items.t: Navitas CTO: Patent Infringers “Will Not Go Unanswered.” Renesas Sued Navitas and Its CEO in July
items.sum: Key TakeawaysNavitas sued Renesas again on November 12, saying new REXGaN and 650 V SuperGaN parts infringe six patents. Renesas sued first in July, alleging trade secret theft by Navitas and former Renesas employees, including CEO Chris Allexandre.

items.t: Navitas Semiconductor (NVTS) Just Posted a Monster Comeback. Here’s What Changed
items.sum: Navitas Semiconductor Corp. (NASDAQ:NVTS) is one of the 10 Stocks With Eye-Popping Gains. Shares of Navitas Semiconductor ended seven straight days of losses on Monday, jumping 20.56 percent to close at $7.33 apiece amid renewed optimism for the broader AI industry, helped bolstered by Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as Nvidia Corp.’s CEO. items.t: Navitas Sinks 15%, Western Down 12%, Everpure Down 13% as AI Chip Rout Deepens
items.sum: Key TakeawaysNavitas Semiconductor fell 15% today with no news of its own, as an AI chip sell-off that started in Asia deepened in New York. Western Digital, Everpure and D-Wave Quantum fell too, as Anthropic slid on its second trading day and California’s attorney general subpoenaed Nvidia.

items.t: POET Stock Drops Amid Tech Weakness and AI Concerns
